embeds.title: 🗡️  Guild Board 1.6.0 is out
embeds.description:
Dungeon night just got easier. Zone in and the **Dungeon tab** shows every quest your group has for that run, who still needs it and who's done, with **Share** and **Ask** buttons right there.

Also new: **ding popups** that tell you which spells and class quests just unlocked (thanks Blexas), a **Soul Shard delete button** for warlocks (thanks John), and **Sell junk** that won't touch your swap gear (thanks medi).

Heads up: minimap left-click now opens **Party & Upkeep**. The To-Do List is taking a break and will be back.

**[⬇️  Download 1.6.0](https://github.com/KrisHendo09/guild-board/releases/latest)**  then fully restart WoW

footer: Something busted? Type /gb bug in game  ·  For the Horde
